Callout.Name: Injury - Domestic
Callout.Message: Person with an injury following a domestic incident.
Callout.Advisory: Patient safe with a neighbour, injury to the arm.

Script.Line: It is the door. I walked into the door.
He has gone. He took the car and he has gone.
If you write it down, he will see it written down. Do you understand what I am saying?

Callout.Patient: It is not as bad as it looks. He has gone.

Lines.Approach: She is next door with the neighbour. The injury needs looking at and so does she.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
